list: the official 55 trophies, verified against TrueAchievements live list + PowerPyx + GTABase, 2026-11-19
notes: Round 2, 2026-11-21: every trophy now carries a 'guide' paragraph in our own words, shown in the app above the steps, with the cited sources below. Names, descriptions and grades are copied exactly from the starter list, which matches the live tracker lists. Triggers marked 'not yet confirmed' are honest unknowns — do not treat them as verified facts.

roadmap.title: Story playthrough — Chapters 1–5
roadmap.text: Play the story to the credits (~60–80 hours). Every story trophy pops automatically; chapter trophies pop a little late, after the first mission(s) of the next chapter. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (trophy 28) the morning after the mission 'Down to Earth' — it is the only trophy that may be missable. Keep cheats off: they disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: Side quests & partner trophies
roadmap.text: After Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break' you can switch characters and call your partner — that unlocks the partner trophies and most side questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal, and the Strangers & Freaks strands). Finish each quest giver's final mission for their trophy. One warning inside this stage: Yago's 'Race Against Yago' is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — do it as soon as it appears in Chapter 3.

roadmap.title: Activities & collectibles
roadmap.text: Work the repeatable systems: stunts, shooting ranges, drone races, races, arcade games, cards, WAiNK scans, meditation spots, garages and car registration. Most of these feed the 100% checklist too, so the effort is never wasted.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & 100% Completion
roadmap.text: After the credits the 100% checklist appears at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (35 requirements in 3 groups). Nothing on it is missable — everything is doable in free-roam. Robberies, vaults, drone trials, shooting-range golds and Bret's Target Decks need full completion; most other items only need a share. Finish the last challenges, the Criminal Profile count (500 actions) and the remaining hidden trophies, then the Platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the Platinum, so there is nothing special to do for it on its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Everything in this atlas funnels into it, from the story chapters to the 100% checklist. Expect the whole run to take around 200 hours, and remember there are no online or DLC trophies standing between you and it.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies — the Platinum pops automatically once the last one lands.
No online, DLC or multiplayer trophy is needed; one playthrough is enough.
Expect roughly 200 hours in total (story 60–80 hours, cleanup about 100 hours).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This is the 100% Completion trophy, and it is the hardest in the list. Finish the story first: the 35-item checklist only becomes viewable afterwards at Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, though progress made during the story already counts. Full completion is required only for the robberies, the 33 Underwater Discoveries, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks; everything else needs only a share, such as 100 optional tasks or 15 of 18 card sets. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be done in free-roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story first: the 100% checklist only becomes viewable afterwards, at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts.
The checklist has 35 requirements in 3 groups: Story & Tasks (12 items, 45%), Exploration & Activities (20 items, 45%), Discovery (3 items, 10%).

Full completion is required only for: all robberies (gang operations, bank jobs, payday loans, 8 vaults), all 33 Underwater Discoveries, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.

Everything else only needs a share — e.g. 100 optional tasks, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied.
Nothing on the checklist is missable; all of it is doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts — the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the Platinum. Four kinds count and mix freely: stunt jumps off ramps, flying under bridges, knife flights between buildings and base jumps by parachute. You only need to perform each stunt once; its optional challenge is not required, and flying under bridges is reported as the quickest way to build the count. Track progress at Progress, Activities, Stunts.
steps: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game (100% needs 300).
Four kinds count and mix freely: 130 Stunt Jumps (ramps), 202 Under the Bridges (fly under bridges), 40 Knife Flights (fly between buildings), 25 Base Jumps (parachute).
Flying under bridges is reported as the quickest way to rack up the count.
You only need to perform each stunt once — its optional challenge is not required. Track progress at Progress > Activities > Stunts, or filter the map by Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold medals in all 12 Shooting Range challenges, which works out to 42 golds in total: six challenges at the Griffin range in northwestern Vice City, each with three gold difficulties, and six at Rodgers Ranch northeast of Port Gellhorn, each with four. Buy a five-dollar Waiver Pass from the clerk at each range first, and rent a weapon you do not own for ten dollars per challenge if you need to. The same 42 golds are required for 100%, so this is a long grind — track it at Progress, Activities, Shooting Ranges.
steps: Earn all 42 gold medals — 12 challenges across 2 ranges, not 42 separate locations.
Griffin Shooting Range (northwestern Vice City): 6 challenges x 3 gold difficulties each = 18 golds, on moving courses.
Rodgers Ranch (northeast of Port Gellhorn): 6 challenges x 4 gold difficulties each = 24 golds, stationary score challenges.
At each range buy a Waiver Pass for $5 from the clerk first; challenges are then marked on the map. Renting a weapon you do not own costs $10 per challenge.
Track progress at Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges. The 100% checklist needs the same 42 golds.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough. There are 42 drone time trials in total, and beating the par time in the first two races at a location unlocks the third, which only needs a finish. Fly at full throttle through the timed course and avoid the obstacles; the locations show as blue icons when you are within about a hundred metres. A full verified list of all 14 location names is not published yet, so find them on the map rather than from a list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida — but not every side questline counts, so do not assume a finished quest giver adds to the total. Four strands are confirmed to count: Kirk and his Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago and his street races, and Pilot Pete's delivery runs. Inside Yago's strand, the Race Against Yago mission is time-sensitive and marked with an hourglass — do it as soon as it appears. The other four qualifying strands are not yet confirmed by any published source, so check the trophy's progress counter in the trophy list before and after finishing a strand.
steps: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Not every side questline counts — only specific strands do.

Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape, 3 missions — the first and last are night-only, the last is Lucia-only; starts Ch. 1, finishes Ch. 2); Kyle (3 missions at McKittrick Farm, Kelly County, from Ch. 2); Yago (4 missions; 'Race Against Yago' is TIME-SENSITIVE with an hourglass icon — do it as soon as it appears, in Ch. 3); Pilot Pete (5 missions, Jason-only, Ch. 4, around Sundown Private Airfield / Wild Hog Airfield).
Confirmed NOT counting: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and Shirley.
The other 4 qualifying strands are not yet confirmed by any published source — check the trophy progress counter in the trophy list before and after finishing a strand.
Stranger strands are not part of 100% completion, but each side mission counts toward the 100 optional tasks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline unlocks automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. Then deliver 16 sports cars from his wish list to his garage in west Vice City, marked with a green RK icon. Randy marks some cars in fixed locations automatically, and you can also steal them off the street — scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted, and hunt around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Still doable after the story.
steps: Unlocks automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — during it you unlock the Key Cloner, and the Zorrusso delivery is part of the story.
Deliver 16 sports cars on Randy's list to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon).

Randy marks some cars in fixed locations automatically; you can also steal them off the street. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the wishlist — a popup appears when you scan or enter a wanted vehicle. Best hunting ground: east Vice City, around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach.
Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Track the list at Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Randy's Wish List.
Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable: Potentially missable (unconfirmed) — the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is only available in Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's ten meditation locations, and always bring your partner: meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts as two. The last spots cannot be done until you can play both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The one warning in the whole game is here: the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony when she says she will meditate, and choose Accept — that balcony meditation is gone forever after Chapter 1. Whether it is strictly required for the trophy is still unconfirmed, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 manual save. Track progress at Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations; 100% needs only 15 of 18.
steps: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with BOTH Jason and Lucia counts as +2 at the same location — always bring your partner.
The final meditation cannot be done until you can play both characters together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break).

WARNING — do this in Chapter 1: the morning after the main mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house; she says she will meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her, look at her, choose 'Accept'. It is permanently unavailable after Chapter 1.

Whether that balcony meditation is strictly required for the trophy is still unconfirmed (it raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a 'Meditation Spot' like the rest) — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 manual save.

Other known spots include the Buckskin Swamp dock (Kelly County), Moonflower Camp on the Emerald River, Manifest Canyon, the water wheel near the paper mill, a waterfall in Lummox County, Mount Kalaga National Park (final one at the very peak), a sandbar west of Capri, and a rocky beach in Leonard County east of Waning Sands.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt for Bret Vogel in a Jason-only questline that unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three of the 18 Collectible Card sets — 480 unique cards in total, and 100% needs 15 sets, so this is a small first step. Cards are found all over the world, inside buildings on surfaces or stuck to walls, and outside in yellow phone boxes or tool boxes; they are finite, so you cannot farm them by buying. The same card can appear in different colour versions, and each colour counts as a unique card, while duplicates found at several locations do not count twice. By arithmetic the quickest sets are Backyard Wrestling with 12 cards and Delights Dancers with 18. Cards can be sold at any pawn shop, but selling does not remove them from your collections list.
steps: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets (480 unique cards in total; 100% needs 15 of 18 sets).
Cards are found all over the world — inside buildings on surfaces or stuck to walls, outside in yellow phone boxes or tool boxes. They are finite; you cannot farm them by buying.
The same card can have different colour versions (Bronze/Silver/Gold, Red/Blue/Purple), and each colour version counts as a unique card. Duplicates found at multiple locations do not count twice.
Fastest path by arithmetic: the smallest sets are Backyard Wrestling (12 cards) and Delights Dancers (18 cards), then any 24-card set.
Cards can be sold at any Pawn Shop ($20 to $1,000+ depending on rarity) — selling does not remove them from your Collections list. Track progress at Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app — any mix counts, and there are more than 100 in total. On foot, hold Up on the D-pad to open WAiNK directly, point the phone at the object and hold R1 to scan; a popup appears when a scannable location is nearby. WAiNK unlocks in Chapter 1, in the mission Unwanted Attention. The locations fall into landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher Tags ground markings — scan every popup you see, since the total count of No Flusher Tags is not published yet. The same 100 scans are required for 100%. Do not confuse location scans with WAiNK vehicle scans, which are a different counter.
steps: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (any mix — there are more than 100 in total).
How to scan: on foot (not in a vehicle), hold Up on the D-pad to open WAiNK directly, point the phone at the object and hold R1/RB. A popup appears when a scannable location is nearby.
WAiNK unlocks in Chapter 1, mission 6 ('Unwanted Attention').
What counts: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags (ground utility markings) — the total count of No Flusher Tags is not yet published, so scan every popup you see.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. 100% needs the same 100 scans. Do not confuse location scans with WAiNK vehicle scans — those are a different counter.

The challenges are 80 objectives in eight categories of ten: Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicle, tracked at Progress, Challenges, where finished ones show a tick. Do this last: many complete naturally while chasing the other trophies, and ten can be skipped entirely for 100%. Then pick off the easiest remaining ones.
